events.name: Bash
events.head: Check push state, audit marks, task state
events.input: $ git log --oneline -1 origin/main && git merge-base --is-ancestor d74b090 origin/main && echo d74-in-origin; git status --short cloud/ app/src | head; grep -n "X019\|X074\|X078\|X079\|X080\|X081" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | cut -c1-60,200-400 | head; python3 -c "import json;t=[x for x in json.load(open('workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json'))['tasks'] if x['id']=='T-265'][0];print(t['status'],t.get('needs_from_owner'));[print(l['ts'],l['note'][:300]) for l in t['log'][-3:]]" 2>&1 | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run T-265 probe and typecheck
events.input: $ node cloud/scripts/probe-t265.mjs 2>&1 | tail -25; (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; echo tsc=$?)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate implementation of each requirement
events.input: $ (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . >/dev/null 2>&1; echo tsc=$?); grep -n "calendar-metrics\|/stats\|metricool\|Metricool\|Not connected\|notConnected\|failed" cloud/src/dashboard.ts | head -30; grep -n "375\|768\|1280\|utm_source\|screenshot\|mcp\|MCP" cloud/src/qa.ts | head -30; grep -rn "build-hours\|buildHoursIcs\|\.ics" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts app/src/lib/calendar.ts app/src/app/onboarding/centre/centre.tsx | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check callers and dashboard rendering
events.input: $ grep -rn "QA_WIDTHS\|qaScreens\|mcpPack\|utm_source" cloud/src --include=*.ts | grep -v "^cloud/src/qa.ts" | head -15; grep -rln "content_clicks\|not_connected" app/src cloud/src cloud/funnel | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find test-run wiring and dashboard renderers
events.input: $ grep -rn "QA_WIDTHS\|screenshotPages\|mcpPack\|utm_source" cloud/src | grep -v "^cloud/src/qa.ts" | cut -c1-220 | head -15; echo ---; grep -rln "content_clicks\|not_connected\|notConnected" app/src cloud/src cloud/funnel app/scripts | head; sed -n 1,60p cloud/src/qa.ts | grep -n "export"

events.text: Verifying the code paths now: dashboard reads, test-run wiring, and how the numbers get rendered.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read dashboard types/sync and test-run QA block
events.input: $ sed -n 20,40p cloud/src/dashboard.ts; sed -n 86,100p cloud/src/dashboard.ts; sed -n 840,880p cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check funnel dashboard renders new fields
events.input: $ grep -n "not_connected\|Not connected\|content.clicks\|\.clicks\|calendar.metrics\|rsvp" cloud/funnel/*.js | cut -c1-200 | head -15; git diff --stat cloud/funnel/worker.js

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect uncommitted worker diff and Not connected rendering
events.input: $ git diff cloud/funnel/worker.js | grep "^[-+]" | cut -c1-200; sed -n 1820,1832p cloud/funnel/worker.js | grep -o "not_connected[^;]*\|Not connected[^<]*" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run dashboard probe; read-only check of test attendee
events.input: $ node app/scripts/probe-dashboard.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4; cd cloud && grep -n "database_name\|binding = \"DB\"" wrangler.toml | head -3; timeout 60 npx wrangler d1 execute $(grep -m1 database_name wrangler.toml | cut -d'"' -f2) --remote --command "SELECT id,name,revoked_at IS NOT NULL AS revoked,is_test FROM attendees WHERE lower(email)='[email]'" 2>&1 | tail -15

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect probe error and wrangler config
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && node app/scripts/probe-dashboard.mjs 2>&1 | head -8; ls cloud/wrangler* ; grep -n "database_name" cloud/wrangler.json* 2>/dev/null | head -3
